partHeading: PART II. HOMEOWNERS INSURANCE CLAIMS HISTORY
bodyText:
PART II. HOMEOWNERS INSURANCE CLAIMS HISTORY

The purpose of this part is to regulate the use of claims history information for homeowners insurance and provide certain consumer protections with respect to the use of this information.
bodyHtml:
PART II.  HOMEOWNERS INSURANCE CLAIMS HISTORY

 

     [§431:10E-121]  Purpose.  The purpose of this part is to regulate the use of claims history information for homeowners insurance and provide certain consumer protections with respect to the use of this information. [L 2012, c 80 pt of §1]
